Q0531

“Virtues are in general beneficial characteristics, and indeed ones that a human…” — Philippa Foot (Virtues and Vices (1978))

Verified English quotation. Primary source: Virtues and Vices (1978). Theme: virtue.

Quotes / Philippa Foot / Q0531

English

Virtues are in general beneficial characteristics, and indeed ones that a human being needs to have, for his own sake and that of his fellows.
Thinker Philippa Foot
School Analytic Philosophy
Source Virtues and Vices (1978)
Theme Virtue

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with Virtues and Vices (1978), within the Analytic Philosophy tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of virtue, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Philippa Foot's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
